concern_results.conclusion: `tracked_paths()` now passes `-c safe.directory=<resolved root>` and runs `-C` on the same resolved path, so the check git does against the repo path will match. `stage_tracked_source` checks each path component with lstat: it rejects symlinked ancestors and the leaf, reports a missing file clearly, and still requires a single-link regular file. Diagnostics derived from repo content or parser errors now go through `display()`. This closes all four prior open items.

The new scrub patterns `ANTIGRAVITY_*|AGY_*` sit in the same unset loop as the other patterns. The test stub fails (exit 9) if those variables reach the child, and the test asserts that the poisoned `ANTIGRAVITY_GEMINI_DIR` path is never created. The staging changes only add rejections and add no new write paths.

A missing working-tree file or a symlinked component now fails closed with a clear message instead of a raw ENOENT. Lstat errors other than ENOENT are rethrown. Tracked symlinks or submodules under the package root still fail closed with 'unsupported git mode', which is documented in `scripts/AGENTS.md`.

Each new behavior has a test that would fail on the old code. The git shim exits 128 when `safe.directory` is missing, so the old `tracked_paths` raises. The YAML and CR runner-entry cases assert that no newline or CR appears in any finding. The `leakedAgyEnv` audit and the missing-file regex would fail without the scrub and the walk. The in-process PATH change is restored in a `finally` block.

Exit codes and sentinel tokens are unchanged, and the extra escaping changes only how diagnostics are rendered. Every change maps to a prior review item inside the Batch A scope. I found no unneeded flags or abstractions.
These are gate and test-harness changes only; nothing is published, migrated or changed irreversibly. Reverting the commit is enough to roll back.
The new failure messages for a missing file or a symlink traversal name the offending path. Hygiene findings stay on one line, so tools that parse the output line by line keep working.

The 29-mutant count and timing figures point to `validation.md`, which is not in the packet, so I could not verify them. They are bookkeeping claims and not material to the code's behavior. The register row matches the diff.
Both shared-gate and release-ops boundaries are tightened, never loosened: the scrub is wider and staging is stricter. No path in the diff bypasses either.

The `scripts/AGENTS.md` update matches the implementation, including the `ANTIGRAVITY_*`/`AGY_*` scrub and the fail-closed staging, and it tightens rather than loosens the rules. The `source-register` change is append-only. It does not conflict with the parent contracts.
